resource.name: ASME K-16/IEEE EPS Cold Plate Design Competition

users: students and instructors reviewing the 2024–2025 cold-plate competition package
supported_tasks: inspect provided CAD and baseline-reference materials
not_intended_for: a current competition rulebook, a manufacturing-ready design, validation of a participant model, or a grant of rights beyond the stated competition terms

required_inputs: the archived competition guidance and participant-specific design context
outputs: historical design guidance and reference CAD materials

limitations: The repository documents the 2024–2025 competition cycle and its deadlines, not a current call.
Provided baseline and CAD materials do not establish a participant design's thermal-hydraulic or manufacturing performance.
